cd /workspace/graphic; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg record . --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json | tail -3; ls; cd /workspace/shots; python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
fs=['onair','stress','clock-paused']
W=960;H=540
im=Image.new('RGB',(W*2,H*2))
for i,f in enumerate(fs):
    a=Image.open(f+'.png').convert('RGBA').resize((W,H))
    bg=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(70,100,70,255)); bg.alpha_composite(a)
    im.paste(bg.convert('RGB'),((i%2)*W,(i//2)*H))
im.save('c.png')"
